name: Notes help
description: Help mode entries for the console's Notes screen (AmberX's notes manager, framed).
author: Brett

entries.title: Notes
entries.text: AmberX's notes and to-do manager, the same one the AmberX app shows: Inbox, Lists, Notes, Pinned and Search, on the one store every device reads on axHub. There is no separate console notes store.

entries.title: Reload
entries.text: Loads AmberX's Notes page again, on the same note, list or tab.

entries.title: Open in AmberX
entries.text: Opens the same page in AmberX itself, in a new tab.

entries.title: Notes settings
entries.text: Where AmberX's Notes page is served from. The notes stay on axHub whatever this says.

steps.say: This is AmberX's notes manager inside the console: the Inbox, your lists and every note, to-do and task.
Anything you change here is changed in AmberX on every device.
